display_long_description:
Survive the Zombie Chaos in VR

The city has fallen. Zombies are everywhere. Your only chance to escape is to protect the engineer while he prepares the system that will get you out.

But there’s one problem…

You don’t have guns.

Instead, you must fight using whatever you can throw.

Grab heavy boxes to knock zombies down.
Launch deadly spinning saw blades that slice enemies in half.
Trigger massive explosions with fuel barrels to clear entire groups of undead.

Every throw is physical, fast, and satisfying in VR.

Across multiple missions you must hold your ground while the engineer works. Zombies will attack from every direction, forcing you to react quickly and use the environment to survive. If the engineer dies, the mission fails.

The longer you survive, the more intense the attacks become.

Use timing, aim, and clever positioning to control the chaos.

Key Features

• Physics-based VR combat – throw objects to defeat zombies
• Three deadly tools – boxes, spinning saw blades, and explosive fuel barrels
• Protect the engineer while he completes critical tasks
• Multiple missions with increasing difficulty
• Fast arcade-style gameplay designed for VR
• Clean low-poly visuals that keep the action clear and readable

Survive the missions.
Protect the engineer.
Escape the undead.
